description: This is a rectangular rug with a complex geometric pattern. The pattern features repeating circular motifs in a golden yellow color, interspersed with floral elements in a lighter greyish-pink. These motifs are connected by intricate, swirling lines in a vibrant teal blue, creating a sense of depth and movement. The background of the rug is a deep navy blue, providing a strong contrast to the lighter, more detailed elements of the design. The texture appears to be that of a woven fabric, possibly wool or a synthetic blend, with a slightly raised, embroidered quality to the patterns.
